metadata.title: Yuzu – Relieve Desk Pain in 5 Min | Personalized Stretching App
metadata.description: Yuzu is the personalized stretching app to relieve pain from sitting at a desk all day. 5-minute routines, no equipment needed, guided by a fun mascot. Available on the App Store.

hero.title: Your desk pain,
hero.subtitle: 5-minute stretching routines, personalized to your pain zone. No equipment, guided by your favorite mascot.

showcase.title: Stretching made simple. Try it for yourself.

feature1.title: Pick your pain zone
feature1.description: Neck, back, shoulders, legs… Tell Yuzu where it hurts. It builds a session 100% tailored to your needs.

feature2.title: Follow guided routines
feature2.description: Step-by-step illustrated exercises with a built-in timer. Every movement is explained simply so you can follow along without thinking.

feature3.title: Celebrate your progress
feature3.description: Yuzu cheers you on after every session. Track your streak and stay motivated with your lemon companion.

review1.text: Since using Yuzu, my back pain after work has almost disappeared. 5 minutes a day was all it took.
review1.author: Claire M.

review2.text: The mascot is adorable and the exercises are really easy to follow. I recommend it to all my remote-working colleagues.
review2.author: Thomas R.

review3.text: Finally a stretching app that doesn't require 30 minutes and equipment. I use it at my desk between meetings.
review3.author: Sophie L.

review4.text: My neck was killing me every evening. After 2 weeks with Yuzu, it's a whole different world. Thank you!
review4.author: Antoine D.

review5.text: Love the concept. The little lemon cheering you on is way better than austere fitness apps. I actually feel motivated.
review5.author: Julie P.

review6.text: Simple, effective, quick. Exactly what I needed for my tense shoulders after hours of coding.
review6.author: Marc B.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Yuzu Labs is committed to protecting the privacy of users of its application and website. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

collection.title: Data Collected
collection.content: We collect the following data: account information (email, name), application usage data, user preferences, and exercise progress data.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used to: personalize your experience, improve our services, send you notifications about your progress, and provide customer support.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website uses essential cookies for the service to function and analytical cookies to improve the user experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at yuzu.contactme@gmail.com.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Your data is kept for the duration of your use of the service and up to 3 years after your last activity, unless otherwise required by law.

contact.title: DPO Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding the protection of your data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer at: yuzu.contactme@gmail.com
